title: How to use AI for sales
description: Learn how Strawberry's Sales skills can help with prospecting, research, customer conversations, CRM updates, and pipeline review.
introduction: Sales teams rarely have the full picture in one place. The CRM shows part of it; the rest is spread across emails, meeting notes, LinkedIn, company websites, and the other tabs your team uses. Pulling that picture together again for every prospect, meeting, and follow-up takes time.

Most sales AI sees one slice of that picture: a CRM record, a call, or whatever you pasted into a chat. Strawberry works across the browser and apps your team already uses. It can open the current sources, use your logged-in tools, bring the account history together, and keep it available for the next task.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the sales work you have open and suggest a useful skill to try first.

skill.context: Use the work and context already in front of you to choose a useful first Sales skill.

sections.title: Find and reach the right customers

blocks.text: Prospecting can start with a new market or a list already sitting in your CRM. Strawberry can research across company sites, LinkedIn, directories, and logged-in tools, show why each prospect fits, and move from a checked sample to the full list you asked for. The same research can then feed contact enrichment and outreach without another round of copy-and-paste.

items.title: Find the part of the market worth pursuing
items.text: Compare segments, companies, and current signals before you spend time building the list.

skill.context: Map the market from current sources and show where the strongest opportunities are.

items.title: Build the prospect list
items.text: Strawberry checks a varied sample with you, then completes the list at the scale you asked for.

skill.context: Find and qualify companies, with the evidence for why each one belongs.

items.title: Find the right people
items.text: Add the contacts and details needed for outreach or qualification without padding the file with fields you will not use.

skill.context: Add and verify the contacts and details you need for the next step.

items.title: Turn the research into outreach
items.text: Draft a single message, a batch, or a coordinated sequence in your voice. You review sending and enrollment separately.

skill.context: Create personalized outreach or a multi-touch sequence from the research you approved.

sections.title: Prepare for and follow up on customer conversations

blocks.text: Good meeting prep and follow-up depend on the same account story. Strawberry can pull together the calendar invite, CRM, email thread, call history, LinkedIn, and current company news before the meeting. Afterward, it can use the transcript or notes to draft the follow-up and update the next steps. You do not have to brief a different tool at every stage.

items.title: Learn what matters before the call
items.text: Go deeper on the company, people, relationship, or recent changes when they could affect the conversation.

skill.context: Research the account, people, relationship, and a credible way into the conversation.

items.title: Walk in prepared
items.text: Bring the account history, meeting goal, open questions, and useful evidence into one short brief.

skill.context: Turn the meeting and account context into a concise brief you can use on the call.

items.title: Follow through while the details are fresh
items.text: Turn the transcript or notes into the follow-up, next actions, and CRM changes that need review.

skill.context: Create the debrief, follow-up, next actions, and proposed CRM updates.

items.title: Build what the buyer needs next
items.text: When an email is not enough, create a one-pager, deck, or tailored page from the same account context.

skill.context: Create the simplest useful sales asset for the next customer decision.

sections.title: Review pipeline and keep the CRM current

blocks.text: The CRM is useful only when it reflects what is actually happening. Strawberry can compare the record with recent meetings, email, commitments, and account signals, then show where deals are stuck and prepare the updates that would make the pipeline trustworthy again.

items.title: See where deals need attention
items.text: Review the activity and commitments behind each stage to find stalled deals, missing next steps, and the actions most likely to move them forward.

skill.context: Find stalled deals, missing next steps, and the actions most likely to move something forward.

items.title: Keep the record current
items.text: After a meeting or follow-up, prepare the exact field changes and show the source before applying them.

skill.context: Review and apply CRM changes with the source and target record in view.

items.title: Know what matters today
items.text: Bring today's meetings, messages, risks, and commitments into one short sales brief.

skill.context: See the sales work that deserves your attention today.

items.title: Share a clear sales picture
items.text: Turn the reviewed pipeline into a concise update for leadership or the team.

skill.context: Create an update from the sales picture you have already reviewed.

blocks.text: As you correct real work, your companion can remember the sources you trust, how you qualify accounts, your writing style, the CRM fields that matter, and where you want to review changes. The next prospect list, brief, or follow-up can start closer to the way your team actually works.

items: Share an approved result when a teammate only needs the output.
Turn a workflow into a team skill when everyone should use the same sources, judgment, and review points.
Create a Routine after the trigger, destination, permissions, and stop conditions are clear.

items.context: Turn a Sales workflow that already works into a shared method for the team.

blocks.text: You do not need to automate the whole sales process at once. Pick one job that repeats this week, make the result genuinely useful, and build from there. Strawberry becomes more valuable as the research, conversations, and records stop resetting between steps.
